definitions.explanation: The muscular organ that pumps blood through the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{心臓|しんぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.notes: Figuratively means someone is bold or shameless

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}{病|びょう}→心臓病：04418_shinzoubyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was hospitalized for heart disease.

examples.japanese: {心臓|しんぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ドキドキ→どきどき：05157_dokidoki⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: ドキドキ is an onomatopoeia for heartbeat

notes:
{心臓|しんぞう} refers to the physical heart organ, not emotional "heart."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {心臓|しんぞう}: heart (the organ)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧: heart (emotions, mind)
- ⟦ハート→ハート：27307_haato⟧: heart (shape, romantic symbol)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心臓|しんぞう}⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧ (heart attack)
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}{病|びょう}→心臓病：04418_shinzoubyou⟧ (heart disease)
- {心臓|しんぞう}⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ (heart surgery)
- {心臓|しんぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (heart stops)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {心臓|しんぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (bold, shameless - lit. "strong heart")
- {心臓|しんぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毛|け}→毛：01392_ke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (extremely bold/shameless)
